name: Cluster + factor analysis of high-DSI/high-PD cells across all 68-d optimisations
short_description: Pool 68-d cells from t0091, t0099, t0102, t0104 with DSI > 0.1 AND PD > 2 Hz, classify by morphological asymmetry, run PCA cluster analysis on intrinsic params, and factor analysis (incl. morphology) on what explains DSI / PD diversity.
